column1: # ALREADY ADJUDICATED THIS WAVE — counted in this lane's 60, no row written to avoid a duplicate id.
# status.wave7.verify-orphans.tsv:26-29 files all four `furniture` off node data, and this lane concurs:
#   10358-10260  Blackjack Desktop   195x277,   ZERO children, x=-2846  (no board width, empty, off-canvas)
#   10404-2119   Blackjack Desktop   1390x1968, ZERO children, x=-7388  (empty, off-canvas)
#   10404-2125   Frame 1000004104    1080x1800, card artwork,  x=-5698  (3:5 poster, same family as the 15 covers above)
# COVERAGE.MJS CLASSIFIER — the precise gap, reported not patched (this lane may not edit that file).
# classify() at coverage.mjs:212-216 is name-regex + type + visibility only. Of the 39 nodes this lane
# CONFIRMS as furniture, not one is reachable by that rule, and they fall into four repairable classes:
#  1. ART-ONLY SUBTREE (27 nodes). A FRAME or GROUP whose whole subtree is RECTANGLE/VECTOR/ELLIPSE/GROUP
#     with ZERO TEXT and, usually, an IMAGE fill. Covers the 15 per-game cover posters and the 12 loose art
#     groups. Suggested signal: genuine requires >0 TEXT descendants OR >0 INSTANCE descendants. Cheap, and
#     it is the discriminator this lane used on all 60. NOTE it would misfile 9900-949 correctly but would
#     ALSO have to spare 10120-8782 (29 TEXT, still a cover) — so it is a strong prior, not a closed rule.
#  2. LIBRARY COMPONENT PATH IN THE NAME (2 nodes: 13006-198774, 13006-294291, both `icons/action`).
#     ★ THE ACTUAL BUG. SCHEMA.md already names `CTA/button` and `logos/others` as furniture, and
#     classify() only catches them via `!SPEC_TYPES.has(n.type)` — i.e. only while they are still INSTANCEs.
#     DETACH one and its type becomes FRAME, which is in SPEC_TYPES, so it silently re-enters the
#     denominator. A name rule such as /^(icons|CTA|logos|labels|buttons|badges)\//i closes it and matches
#     the vocabulary SCHEMA.md already uses.
#  3. AUTHOR DEPRECATION LABEL (2 nodes: 11151-81849 `... not to be used immediately`, 9112-13214
#     `cards - roultette OLD`). FURNITURE_NAME has /^Unrecommended/i but anchored at the START, so a
#     suffix is unreachable. A /\b(OLD|DEPRECATED|not to be used|do not use)\b/i test would catch both.
#     ⚠ These must stay a REPORTED list, never a silent exclusion — a deprecation is reversible.
#  4. SIZE FLOOR (5 nodes: 9798-13760 28x28, 9903-2037 37x18, 9903-2040 35x18, plus the two icons above).
#     Nothing under ~64px in either axis is a surface at any breakpoint. Deliberately NOT proposed as an
#     automatic rule — a small COMPONENT is genuine design work — but it is what settled these five.
# ★ None of this is a defect in the classifier's DOCUMENTED intent. coverage.mjs:180-187 states plainly
#   that the name list is "deliberately only the KNOWN canvas-chrome vocabulary" and that guessing intent
#   would "quietly shrink the denominator and raise the percentage". Class 2 is the one true bug; classes
#   1, 3 and 4 are the disclosed cost of that conservatism, and this lane is the hand pass it assumes.
